oneFilter.intro: Before I say yes to anything, or pick what to work on, run it through this:
questions: Does it move D-One toward autonomous? (Client's + contractor's favourite subcontractor · interchangeable humans · Darren out one month at a time.) Or is it just chase-mode?
Is it the current bottleneck? (Growth Wheel.) Or a shiny distraction from the real constraint?
Do I have capacity? I am a basket — rest fills it, output empties it. Am I resting as much as I'm outputting? Am I inside my 20% buffer?
If it's a deal: Is it what we actually want, and do we hold the power seat? The one willing to walk away has the most power.

Is this slot actually free? A blank space is not automatically free — before I say yes, check the board for what else could have gone there (surf, rest, family, focus). Every yes is a no to something else.

active.title: Discuss the Trust -> HoldCo -> OpCo structure with Amanda
active.context: From Billionaire Mindset session (Daniel). Walk Amanda through the structure: Trust holds shares in HoldCo, HoldCo holds shares in OpCo. OpCo builds value/cash; keep 6 months' expenses buffer in OpCo, then pay dividends OpCo->HoldCo (company-to-company, tax-free). Never pay dividends OpCo->Trust directly (taxed in beneficiaries' hands). Keep HoldCo clean: only holds shares and invests.

parkingLot.title: Neurodiversity Centre — session findings (rhythm, saying yes)
notes: Find my OWN rhythm + structure that works for me — that's what prevents things going haywire / spiralling.
Set a few high-level outcomes I want across the week, then fit them in when it suits — flexible, not a rigid schedule.
Be very careful saying yes / committing. Every yes is a no to something else.
A blank calendar space is not automatically free — check the board first for what else could go there before agreeing.
Awareness around calendar management is the practice to build.

parkingLot.title: EO Forum retreat — reflections (Peace / State / Value)
notes: Peace → the level to reach.
Gratitude → broken ceiling → love → abundance (gratitude breaks the ceiling; opens love, then abundance).
Proving yourself — to who? (Question the audience you're performing for.)
Q: What do you deserve?
KEY: Reaching a STATE is through PRACTICING it — not an outcome.
Confidence builds through consistently showing up.
Detachment from outcome creates space for potency.
Having something to pour love into allows love to pour through me.
I'm not selling. I'm sharing value — and people can buy in if they see the value.

parkingLot.title: Boukou property portfolio + D-One Property Management (Catchup, Aug 12)
notes: Opportunity: Boukou (a couple) own 11 properties being redeveloped into luxury homes. Inherit the maintenance SLA for all 11 now to preserve the relationship through development; they eventually become full D-One projects.

Rough SLA estimate: ~R3,800/property x 11 = ~R41k/month (~R500k/yr). Illustrative only - each property needs individual scoping. Base call-out price per property regardless of system count, then scales per system.

Subcontracting (e.g. Benji ~R450/hr + markup) is thin-margin; employing someone at R20-25k/mo likely more profitable once volume justifies. Interim: subcontract while finding the right permanent person.

Entity decision: Stafford proposed a separate 'D-One Property Management' (and possibly 'D-One Air Services'). Amanda: a separate entity doubles fixed costs and erodes margin. AGREED: keep as an internal D-One department/project with a separate P&L in Xero; annuity income raises D-One's valuation (a separate entity wouldn't). Stafford + Darren to agree profit-share internally.

After-hours support: currently all falls on Darren + Stafford, often non-D-One (ISP/electrical). Proposal: rotate duty between Tristan and Macal, remunerate staff, bill SLA clients a premium after-hours rate. Idea: WhatsApp bot (Tech/Banana framework) auto-routes after-6pm/weekend calls to the on-duty tech with a 'billed at double rate' auto-message; tag WhatsApp contacts by client.

Odoo: Darren wants an at-a-glance all-projects dashboard, tailored per role (needs live data first). Labour category linking - Caleb to classify all product subcategories as installation / cabling / programming (default at price-list level, overridable per quote).

Notifii: add Tech + Amanda as team members (paid plan, extra cost) - Tech to research multi-user access. V1593: Darren forwarding drawings to Tech to attach to the Odoo CRM task and build a proposal (likely a new prospect).
